final_stack.choice: Monorepo: frontend/ backend/ engine/ contracts/ docker/ docs/ .github/ + root config
final_stack.why: Four build concerns + shared contract + infra, each a disjoint owner_dir so builders work in parallel. Repo already initialized (branch master, 0 commits) with these dirs scaffolded.

final_stack.choice: React 19.3 + TypeScript 5.9.3 + Vite 7.3.7 + @vitejs/plugin-react 5.2.0 + CesiumJS 1.146 (one persistent GlobeView), Zustand 5 (immer+persist), uPlot 1.6.32, zod 4; npm (no pnpm/yarn on host)
final_stack.why: CesiumJS 3D Mars globe is the PRIMARY product. Mature Vite 7 line chosen over bleeding-edge Vite 8/plugin-react 6 (Rolldown/oxc) and TS 7 because typescript-eslint 8.71 requires TS <6.1 and the capstone must reliably RUN.

final_stack.choice: Ellipsoid.default = Mars radii (3396190/3396190/3376200) set in main.tsx BEFORE any Viewer; GeographicTilingScheme (2 cols x 1 row at z0); Earth chrome disabled; EllipsoidTerrainProvider; pick via camera.pickEllipsoid (never pickPosition); requestRenderMode on
final_stack.why: Matches the verified NASA Trek EQ equirectangular 2x1 grid so basemaps and result overlays co-register with no reprojection. pickEllipsoid is the only reliable lon/lat pick with flat terrain.

final_stack.choice: Python 3.12 + FastAPI 0.143 (app factory + lifespan) + SQLModel/SQLAlchemy 2.x async + pydantic 2.14; imports app.schemas (does not redefine shapes)
final_stack.why: GDAL/rasterio/rio-tiler/spectral/scikit-learn ecosystem is Python and installed on host. Pydantic already governs the wire; app.schemas is the single source of truth generating contracts/openapi.yaml.

final_stack.choice: DEFAULT SQLite (aiosqlite, footprint as GeoJSON text + denormalized minx/miny/maxx/maxy bbox columns, zero setup); PRODUCTION PostgreSQL+PostGIS (asyncpg, Geometry(POLYGON,104905)+GiST) selected by DATABASE_URL. Hybrid migrations: metadata.create_all for SQLite, Alembic for Postgres
final_stack.why: Runs out-of-the-box with no infra for dev (hard constraint); production path available via one env var. bbox columns give dialect-agnostic viewport filtering with no SpatiaLite dependency.

final_stack.choice: DEFAULT in-process asyncio worker (asyncio.Queue + lifespan task + anyio.to_thread for the CPU-bound engine call, JOB_CONCURRENCY cap, per-job wait_for timeout); PRODUCTION arq+Redis via JOB_BACKEND=arq + compose --profile worker. Both write identical status/progress to analysis_job; client polls GET /api/analysis-jobs/{id}. No SSE/websockets in v1
final_stack.why: No extra infra for the default demo path; horizontal scale available via config. Polling keeps the contract trivial for frontend and CI.

final_stack.choice: On-the-fly tiling from the engine COG via rio-tiler over a CUSTOM morecantile Mars GEOGRAPHIC TileMatrixSet (z0=2x1), served at GET /api/results/{id}/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png (tile_order zxy); color baked server-side with colormap+value_range, transparent nodata. SingleTile /preview.png is the small-bbox fallback. AnalysisResult.map_layer (type=result_tiles) is the canonical ready-to-add Cesium layer object
final_stack.why: Geographic (NOT WebMercator) tiling is mandatory so overlays register pixel-for-pixel with Trek equirectangular basemaps. Embedding a MapLayer lets the frontend layer manager treat catalog and result layers uniformly (single append).

final_stack.choice: Standalone marsgis_engine package (src/ layout, py.typed) exposing a Python API (run_sam) AND a marsgis-engine CLI; invoked by backend through one EngineAdapter seam: ENGINE_MODE=inprocess (import, dev default) or subprocess|container (ghcr.io/<account>/marsgis-engine, rlimits) for isolation. Vectorized numpy SAM, row-block chunked, emits angle COG (float32 radians) + candidate mask COG (uint8) + provenance.json + report.txt in the input Mars CRS. No recalibration, no reprojection
final_stack.why: MTRDR is analysis-ready I/F; outputs inherit the input grid losslessly. In-process is fastest for dev/CI; container gives a hard boundary for untrusted public workloads.

final_stack.choice: contract_version 1.0.0. app.schemas (Pydantic v2, extra=forbid) authoritative -> contracts/openapi.yaml GENERATED via gen_openapi.py -> frontend/src/types hand-written TS mirror (tsc --strict clean, NOT openapi-typescript codegen). contracts/enums.json pins every closed vocabulary + SAM/tile defaults for all three languages
final_stack.why: One source of truth that cannot silently drift; CI asserts live /openapi.json equals the committed spec. Resolves the frontend 'generate schema.d.ts' vs data-model 'hand-written mirror' overlap in favor of the already-built, compile-checked mirror.

final_stack.choice: Mars IAU 2000 degrees everywhere: lon east-positive [-180,180], planetocentric lat [-90,90], CRS 104905. Centralized normalizeLon helper; GeoJSON carries plain degrees (datum documented in enums.json.crs)
final_stack.why: Trek advertises urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::104905; aligning footprints, basemaps, result tiles, gazetteer and pixel queries on one documented convention prevents misplacement.

final_stack.choice: Docker + docker compose (v2 plugin). All images multi-stage, non-root (uid 10001). engine/backend base python:3.12-slim-bookworm with rasterio from PyPI wheels (vendored GDAL>=3.8, no system libgdal); frontend node:24 build -> nginx-unprivileged serve. compose: db+backend+frontend default; engine/worker/redis/titiler behind profiles; all ports 127.0.0.1-bound. GHCR publish on git tag
final_stack.why: Pinned 3.12 (not host 3.14) for broadest scientific-wheel coverage; wheels decouple Python from any GDAL base-image coupling. Localhost binds because the dev stack is unauthenticated.

final_stack.choice: Python 3.12 in all containers + CI (host 3.14 best-effort local only); Node 24 LTS in Docker/CI (host 26 local only). Deps hash-locked (pip --require-hashes); version from git tags via setuptools-scm/hatch-vcs
final_stack.why: Reproducibility needs one pinned interpreter for the whole tree, not whatever the host runs.

api_contract.response: HealthResponse{status, version, contract_version:'1.0.0', git_sha, time, components{db,engine,tiler,queue:{status,detail,latency_ms}}, implemented_algorithms:['SAM']}
api_contract.notes: Liveness + capability probe. Reports job_backend (inprocess|arq) and engine_mode.
Cesium imagery config: Trek basemaps (tile_order=zyx, file_extension per product jpg|png) + any overlays. Only VERIFIED products ship default_visible; others availability=unconfirmed.
Summary keeps footprint+bbox for the map; drops spectral/quality/source_url. bbox filter = numeric range on SQLite, ST_Intersects on PostGIS. Returns footprints the globe draws as clickable polygons.
id is provider-native, stored verbatim (e.g. 'frt00003e12'). Full record incl. footprint GeoJSON, spectral summary, quality.
Light picker list, NO wavelength/reflectance arrays. MICA references, carbonate first.
Arrays feed the uPlot spectral plot; split from the list to keep the picker light.

api_contract.request: AnalysisJobCreate{observation_id, algorithm:'SAM', reference_id, params?:Partial<SamParams>} + optional Idempotency-Key header
api_contract.notes: Validates observation exists & analysis_suitable, reference exists, algorithm implemented (SID/BAND_RATIO -> 422). Enum-only method = no arbitrary exec. Quota-guarded (per-client concurrency + hourly). SamParams defaults: threshold_rad 0.10, continuum_removed true, wavelength_subset_nm [1000,2600].
Poll target. Lifecycle queued->running->succeeded|failed; terminal states have no outgoing transitions. v1 has no websockets/SSE.
map_layer is a ready MapLayer(type=result_tiles). caveat REQUIRED (CANDIDATE_MATCH_CAVEAT) on result, summary_stats, legend.
On-the-fly rio-tiler over custom Mars GEOGRAPHIC TMS (z0=2x1), tile_order zxy, 256px. Color baked server-side; transparent nodata. Immutable Cache-Control. z/x/y bounded.
SingleTileImageryProvider fallback for tiny bboxes; max_size bounded to prevent huge in-memory decode.
id from AnalysisResult.provenance_id. Reproducibility record incl. engine image digest.
MUST equal contracts/openapi.yaml (CI equality check). Source of the frontend TS mirror pin.

data_sources.name: PDS ODE REST API (CRISM MTRDR discovery)
data_sources.fetch_strategy: live_proxy_with_cache; backend passthrough with bbox filter (Nili Fossae [74,20,78,24] -> 23 products, WKT footprints + per-file URLs). No auth, no bulk download. Seeded offline into crism_nili_catalogue.json.

data_sources.name: PDS Geosciences MTRDR archive (ENVI cubes)
data_sources.fetch_strategy: live_proxy_stream_on_demand; backend streams only the one selected observation's _if cube (100-300MB) and caches it; never bulk-mirror. ENVI BSQ float32, ignore=65535, nm wavelengths; GDAL/rasterio read directly (gdalinfo verified).

data_sources.name: CRISM MICA reference library (.tab)
data_sources.fetch_strategy: bundled subset (carbonate/olivine/clay .tab, few KB, public domain) ships in engine/src/marsgis_engine/data/mica/; remainder opt-in via marsgis-engine fetch-references. .lbl: col1 wavelength um, col2 ratioed I/F corrected (SAM reference).

data_sources.name: USGS SIM 3292 geologic map (OGC API-Features)
data_sources.fetch_strategy: live GeoJSON vectors with bbox filter (units/contacts/structure), rendered as a styled Cesium GeoJsonDataSource overlay; bundled Nili-clipped GeoJSON fallback offline. NOTE: units collection path uses prefix sim3292_global_geologic_map, contacts/structure use global_geologic_map.

data_sources.name: NASA Mars Trek basemaps (WMTS)
data_sources.fetch_strategy: direct browser fetch (CORS open) with optional backend /trek proxy. RE-VERIFIED THIS SESSION HTTP 200: Viking_MDIM21_ClrMosaic_232m (jpg), MGS_MOLA_ClrShade_merge_463m (jpg), mola128_mola64_merge_90Nto90S_SimpleC_clon0 (png), THEMIS_DayIR_ControlledMosaics_100m_v2_oct2018 (png). Grid 2x1 z0, order {z}/{row=y}/{col=x} (zyx), extension per-product. Earlier guessed MOLA-DEM/THEMIS ids 404'd.

data_sources.name: Bundled synthetic sample (offline/CI)
data_sources.fetch_strategy: committed tiny fixtures (~540KB cube); GDAL-readable (verified), deterministic SAM separates carbonate 0.23deg vs olivine 7.65deg. Enables full pipeline + tiles + CI with zero network. Labelled SYNTHETIC throughout; never presented as a real detection.

conflicts_resolved.conflict: Result raster display: frontend proposed client-side XYZ-vs-SingleTile selected by metadata; backend/data-model proposed on-the-fly rio-tiler tile endpoint over a custom Mars geographic TMS.
conflicts_resolved.resolution: CANONICAL = backend on-the-fly rio-tiler endpoint GET /api/results/{id}/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png over a custom morecantile Mars GEOGRAPHIC TMS (z0=2x1), color baked server-side. AnalysisResult.map_layer (MapLayer type=result_tiles, tile_order=zxy) is the ready display object the frontend consumes directly. SingleTile /preview.png is the small-bbox fallback, chosen by map_layer.source. Frontend does NO raster math.

conflicts_resolved.conflict: Job queue: in-process asyncio worker vs arq+Redis vs 'async + poll'.
conflicts_resolved.resolution: DEFAULT in-process asyncio worker (no infra, out-of-the-box). PRODUCTION arq+Redis via JOB_BACKEND=arq + compose --profile worker. Both write identical status/progress to analysis_job; API backend-agnostic. Client polls GET /api/analysis-jobs/{id}. v1 drops SSE/websockets entirely (keep the 4-state enum and polling only).

conflicts_resolved.conflict: DB abstraction: SQLModel single async engine + bbox columns vs PostGIS-geometry-required vs SQLite fallback.
conflicts_resolved.resolution: SQLModel/SQLAlchemy 2.x async, single engine. DEFAULT SQLite (aiosqlite, footprint GeoJSON text + denormalized bbox columns). PRODUCTION PostgreSQL+PostGIS (asyncpg, geometry 104905 + GiST + ST_Intersects) via DATABASE_URL. Hybrid migrations: metadata.create_all for SQLite dev, Alembic (upgrade head) for Postgres. bbox columns give dialect-agnostic viewport filtering; no SpatiaLite.

conflicts_resolved.resolution: Pin Python 3.12 in ALL containers and CI (broadest scientific-wheel coverage). requires-python>=3.12 for backend and engine. Host 3.14 is best-effort local tooling only; docs direct non-Docker devs to a 3.12 venv (uv/pyenv). Docker/compose/CI are authoritative.

conflicts_resolved.resolution: Docker/CI build on node:24 LTS (authoritative, .nvmrc=24). Local dev on host node 26 is fine. Frontend toolchain stays pinned at Vite 7.3.7 / plugin-react 5.2.0 / TS 5.9.3 (not Vite 8 / plugin-react 6 / TS 7).

Drop the openapi-typescript gen:api step and schema.d.ts. app.schemas (Pydantic) is authoritative -> contracts/openapi.yaml generated -> TS mirror kept in lockstep by contract_version + CI equality check (live /openapi.json == contracts/openapi.yaml). PRODUCTION/isolation ENGINE_MODE=subprocess|container (ghcr.io/<account>/marsgis-engine) with RLIMIT_CPU/RLIMIT_AS + wall-clock timeout for untrusted public workloads. conflicts_resolved.resolution: CANONICAL = contracts/openapi.yaml (already generated and validated). Backend's runtime /openapi.json must equal it (CI check). No separate hand-authored openapi.json.

conflicts_resolved.conflict: Shared files living inside sibling service dirs (Dockerfile, .dockerignore, backend/entrypoint.sh, frontend/nginx/) vs service ownership.
conflicts_resolved.resolution: The infra-root unit OWNS these specific files although they physically sit under frontend/backend/engine; service units MUST NOT create them. Service units own their own pyproject.toml + hash-locked requirements.txt + package.json (deps are the service's knowledge). File-level ownership stays disjoint even though directories nest.

conflicts_resolved.conflict: Trek product ids / tile extension (jpg vs png) and tile order.
conflicts_resolved.resolution: Store per-product file_extension + tile_order in MapLayer.source; probe LayerAvailability at startup. VERIFIED (re-confirmed 200 this session): Viking (jpg), MOLA ClrShade (jpg) both zyx; MOLA-DEM mola128_mola64_merge_90Nto90S_SimpleC_clon0 (png), THEMIS_DayIR_ControlledMosaics_100m_v2_oct2018 (png). Result overlays use zxy. Only verified layers ship default_visible.

CANDIDATE_MATCH_CAVEAT is a single constant in contracts/enums.json, enforced as a REQUIRED field on AnalysisResult, SummaryStats, Legend and Provenance, and surfaced in StatusBar/InspectorPanel/ResultsPanel/SpectralAngleBadge. The continuous angle raster is always retained alongside the mask. A result without the caveat is structurally unrepresentable.

Live tile fetch (data path proven): `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{content_type}\n' 'https://trek.nasa.gov/tiles/Mars/EQ/Mars_Viking_MDIM21_ClrMosaic_global_232m/1.0.0//default/default028mm/0/0/0.jpg'` expect 200 image/jpeg (RE-VERIFIED this session; MOLA-DEM/THEMIS at /0/0/0.png also 200).

Frontend build + tests: `cd frontend && npm ci && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test -- --run && npm run build` -> dist/ emitted, Cesium assets copied, vitest LayerManager/geo/format pass with no WebGL.

Frontend offline smoke: `VITE_USE_MOCKS=true npm run dev` -> globe renders Mars (dark base even if tiles blocked), footprints from bundled sample draw, a mock SAM job completes and overlays a result with the candidate caveat visible.

Full stack via Docker: `cp .env.example .env && make up` (docker compose, db+backend+frontend) -> `curl -s localhost:8000/api/health` ok, open http://127.0.0.1:8080, verify globe + Trek basemap + Nili Fossae footprints; submit a SAM job (carbonate, frt00003e12), poll to succeeded, confirm result tiles register on the globe and the StatusBar/legend show 'candidate spectral match, not a confirmed mineral deposit'.

Production path smoke (config only): `DATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg://... JOB_BACKEND=arq docker compose --profile worker up` -> alembic upgrade head creates PostGIS 104905 geometry + GiST; a job routed through arq+Redis reaches succeeded identically.
CI parity: push a branch -> ci.yml frontend/python/docker-build jobs green offline, openapi equality check passes, hadolint clean.
v1_acceptance_checklist: App runs out-of-the-box with NO extra infra: `cp .env.example .env && make up` (or backend `uvicorn` + frontend `npm run dev`) brings up a working map on SQLite + in-process worker + in-process engine, seeded with verified Nili Fossae data.

Primary product is the map: one persistent CesiumJS Mars globe (Mars ellipsoid radii 3396190/3396190/3376200, GeographicTilingScheme 2x1) with the verified Viking + MOLA-ClrShade Trek basemaps rendering.
CRISM MTRDR footprints over Nili Fossae draw as clickable polygons from GET /api/observations (seeded offline; frt00003e12 the primary scene).

End-to-end SAM experiment works: pick observation + MICA carbonate reference -> POST /api/analysis-jobs (202) -> poll -> succeeded -> AnalysisResult with angle COG + candidate mask COG + stats + legend + provenance.

Result overlays register pixel-for-pixel on the globe via GET /api/results/{id}/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png over the custom Mars geographic TMS (geographic, NOT WebMercator); SingleTile /preview.png fallback works for tiny bboxes.
Pixel inspector: clicking a result pixel plots its reflectance-vs-wavelength spectrum against the MICA reference (uPlot) with the spectral angle shown.

Scientific honesty enforced: CANDIDATE_MATCH_CAVEAT is a required field on AnalysisResult/SummaryStats/Legend/Provenance and visibly rendered; the continuous angle raster is always retained; no result is ever labelled a confirmed deposit.

Contract is single-source and drift-proof: app.schemas -> contracts/openapi.yaml generated; frontend/src/types mirror is tsc --strict clean; backend /openapi.json equals the committed spec (CI-checked); contract_version 1.0.0.
Data fetched via APIs/services only (ODE, PDS archive, MICA, USGS pygeoapi, Trek) — no bulk archive in the repo; only tiny synthetic/sample fixtures committed; pipeline + all tests run fully offline.
Coordinates consistent everywhere: Mars IAU 2000 degrees, east-positive lon [-180,180], planetocentric lat [-90,90]; footprint centroids land on the correct basemap features.
Production path available by config only: DATABASE_URL->PostGIS, JOB_BACKEND=arq (--profile worker), ENGINE_MODE=container — no code change.
Standalone engine artifact: marsgis-engine CLI + Python API + ghcr.io/<account>/marsgis-engine image, versioned from git tag.
Quality gates green: frontend lint+typecheck+vitest+build; backend+engine ruff+pytest; docker-build smoke; all offline in CI.

Security posture explicit: dev stack binds 127.0.0.1, unauthenticated job submission is hard-bounded (enum method, AOI/count caps, per-client concurrency+hourly quota, per-job timeout+rlimits), REQUIRE_API_KEY gate available and flagged mandatory for public hosting.
Builders worked in parallel without collision: every needed file lives in exactly one owner_dir unit; shared-contract files frozen and depended upon.
